_source: CharacterSheet and UnitSize (RECONSTRUCTION 4.1, 4.8). Owner decision 2026-10-23: Shanoa and Leo are playable as well as Morris (built by U.VAN-T25); in the original only Morris was, the others by editing a field. A move set lists the actions a character can perform.

nameTag._about: SceneManager.DrawText (RECONSTRUCTION 6, item 4): every character's name written twice in Arial 10, centred on its x and Top-aligned, red at (X - 1, Y - 100) and then yellow at (X, Y). TextWriter's Top alignment lifts the text by its measured height * fontSize (10) * 0.4; Arial 10 measures 16 px high, so 64 px: the yellow name sits at the top of the 64 px frame and the red one 100 px above it. Drawn over every character, after all of them.
